/**
 * PersonalProfilePage —— 个人资料
 *
 * 支持设置：名称、头像、电话、住址、邮箱、个人简介、座右铭；
 * 修改密码走真实 API（R7 清零本地模拟点：POST /auth/change-password，R6-1 首次登录强制改密同端点）。
 */
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Alert, Avatar, Button, Card, Col, Descriptions, Form, Input, Modal, Row, Space, Typography, Upload, message } from 'antd'
import { EditOutlined, LockOutlined, UploadOutlined, UserOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons'
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useUsers } from '@/hooks/useUsers'
import { authApi } from '@/api/authApi'
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/api/errors'
 
const { Title, Text } = Typography
 
function fileToBase64(file: File): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader()
    reader.readAsDataURL(file)
    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string)
    reader.onerror = reject
  })
}
 
export default function PersonalProfilePage() {
  const { me, updateMe } = useUsers()
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams()
  // R6-1：登录页 mustChangePassword 跳转携带 forceChangePassword=1 → 顶部提示 + 自动弹出改密弹窗
  const forceChangePassword = searchParams.get('forceChangePassword') === '1'
  const [editOpen, setEditOpen] = useState(false)
  const [pwdOpen, setPwdOpen] = useState(forceChangePassword)
  const [form] = Form.useForm()
  const [pwdForm] = Form.useForm()
  const [avatar, setAvatar] = useState<string | null>(me.avatarUrl)
  const [pwdSubmitting, setPwdSubmitting] = useState(false)
 
  const handleEdit = (values: {
    displayName: string
    email: string
    phone?: string
    address?: string
    bio?: string
    motto?: string
  }) => {
    updateMe({
      ...values,
      avatarUrl: avatar,
    })
    setEditOpen(false)
    message.success('个人资料已保存')
  }
 
  const handleChangePassword = async (values: { oldPassword: string; newPassword: string; confirmPassword: string }) => {
    if (values.newPassword !== values.confirmPassword) {
      message.error('两次输入的新密码不一致')
      return
    }
    // R7：改密走真实 API（POST /auth/change-password；首次登录强制改密同端点，R6-1）
    setPwdSubmitting(true)
    try {
      await authApi.changePassword(values.oldPassword, values.newPassword)
      setPwdOpen(false)
      pwdForm.resetFields()
      message.success('密码已修改')
    } catch (e) {
      message.error(getErrorMessage(e))
    } finally {
      setPwdSubmitting(false)
    }
  }
 
  const beforeUpload = async (file: File) => {
    if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
      message.error('请上传图片文件')
      return false
    }
    if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
      message.error('头像大小不能超过 2MB')
      return false
    }
    try {
      const base64 = await fileToBase64(file)
      setAvatar(base64)
      message.success('头像已更新，请保存资料')
    } catch {
      message.error('头像读取失败')
    }
    return false
  }
 
  return (
    <div style={{ padding: 24, maxWidth: 960, margin: '0 auto' }}>
      {forceChangePassword && (
        <Alert
          type="warning"
          showIcon
          icon={<LockOutlined />}
          message="首次登录需要修改密码"
          description="这是管理员为你创建的临时密码，请先完成改密后再继续使用。"
          style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
        />
      )}
      <Title level={3} style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>个人资料</Title>
 
      <Row gutter={[24, 24]}>
        <Col xs={24} md={8}>
          <Card style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
            <Avatar
              size={120}
              src={me.avatarUrl || undefined}
              icon={<UserOutlined />}
              style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
            />
            <Title level={5} style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>{me.displayName}</Title>
            <Text type="secondary">{me.email}</Text>
            <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
              <Space>
                <Button type="primary" icon={<EditOutlined />} onClick={() => {
                  setAvatar(me.avatarUrl)
                  form.setFieldsValue({
                    displayName: me.displayName,
                    email: me.email,
                phone: me.phone ?? '',
                address: me.address ?? '',
                bio: me.bio ?? '',
                motto: me.motto ?? '',
                  })
                  setEditOpen(true)
                }}>
                  编辑资料
                </Button>
              <Button
                icon={<LockOutlined />}
                type={forceChangePassword ? 'primary' : 'default'}
                onClick={() => setPwdOpen(true)}
              >
                {forceChangePassword ? '立即修改密码' : '修改密码'}
              </Button>
              </Space>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </Col>
 
        <Col xs={24} md={16}>
          <Card
            title="基本信息"
            extra={<TagStatus status={me.status} />}
          >
            <Descriptions column={{ xs: 1, sm: 2 }} bordered>
              <Descriptions.Item label="名称">{me.displayName}</Descriptions.Item>
              <Descriptions.Item label="邮箱">{me.email}</Descriptions.Item>
              <Descriptions.Item label="电话">{me.phone || '-'}</Descriptions.Item>
              <Descriptions.Item label="住址">{me.address || '-'}</Descriptions.Item>
              <Descriptions.Item label="个人简介" span={2}>{me.bio || '-'}</Descriptions.Item>
              <Descriptions.Item label="座右铭" span={2}>{me.motto || '-'}</Descriptions.Item>
            </Descriptions>
          </Card>
        </Col>
      </Row>
 
      <Modal
        title="编辑个人资料"
        open={editOpen}
        onCancel={() => setEditOpen(false)}
        onOk={() => form.submit()}
        okText="保存"
        cancelText="取消"
        width={640}
      >
        <Form form={form} layout="vertical" onFinish={handleEdit}>
          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <Avatar size={80} src={avatar || undefined} icon={<UserOutlined />} style={{ marginBottom: 8 }} />
            <div>
              <Upload beforeUpload={beforeUpload} accept="image/*" showUploadList={false}>
                <Button icon={<UploadOutlined />}>更换头像</Button>
              </Upload>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Row gutter={16}>
            <Col span={12}>
              <Form.Item name="displayName" label="名称" rules={[{ required: true, message: '请输入名称' }]}>
                <Input />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>
            <Col span={12}>
              <Form.Item name="email" label="邮箱" rules={[{ required: true, type: 'email', message: '请输入有效邮箱' }]}>
                <Input />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>
          </Row>
          <Row gutter={16}>
            <Col span={12}>
              <Form.Item name="phone" label="电话">
                <Input />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>
            <Col span={12}>
              <Form.Item name="address" label="住址">
                <Input />
              </Form.Item>
            </Col>
          </Row>
          <Form.Item name="bio" label="个人简介">
            <Input.TextArea rows={3} placeholder="一句话介绍自己" />
          </Form.Item>
          <Form.Item name="motto" label="座右铭">
            <Input placeholder="你的座右铭" />
          </Form.Item>
        </Form>
      </Modal>
 
      <Modal
        title={forceChangePassword ? '首次登录：修改临时密码' : '修改密码'}
        open={pwdOpen}
        onCancel={() => { if (!forceChangePassword) setPwdOpen(false) }}
        onOk={() => pwdForm.submit()}
        confirmLoading={pwdSubmitting}
        closable={!forceChangePassword}
        maskClosable={!forceChangePassword}
        okText="确认修改"
        cancelText="取消"
      >
        <Form form={pwdForm} layout="vertical" onFinish={handleChangePassword}>
          <Form.Item name="oldPassword" label="当前密码" rules={[{ required: true, message: '请输入当前密码' }]}>
            <Input.Password />
          </Form.Item>
          <Form.Item name="newPassword" label="新密码" rules={[{ required: true, min: 8, message: '密码至少 8 位' }]}>
            <Input.Password />
          </Form.Item>
          <Form.Item name="confirmPassword" label="确认新密码" rules={[{ required: true, message: '请确认新密码' }]}>
            <Input.Password />
          </Form.Item>
        </Form>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  )
}
 
function TagStatus({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const color = status === 'active' ? 'green' : 'red'
  const label = status === 'active' ? '启用中' : '已禁用'
  return <Typography.Text type="secondary" style={{ color: `var(--ant-${color})` }}>{label}</Typography.Text>
}
